user.title: Sunrise Alarm

data.name: Name
data.hold_minutes: Extra light time after wake-up (0 = leave on)

user.description: Set the lights, a wake-up time and the days it runs. Afterwards the card sets a time per day.

init.title: Sunrise Alarm

data.hold_minutes: Extra light time after wake-up (0 = leave on)

init.description: Change the lights and the sunrise. The schedule lives on the card.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Length of the sunrise in minutes. Defaults to the configured duration.

stop.name: Stop sunrise
stop.description: Stops the running sunrise and turns the lights off.

snooze.name: Snooze
snooze.description: Turns the lights off and runs a short sunrise again later.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How long to snooze. Defaults to the configured snooze time.

set_days.name: Set days
set_days.description: Runs the alarm on these weekdays only, keeping each day's time.

days.name: Days
days.description: Weekdays to run on, as mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat, sun.

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Replaces the schedule with a wake-up time per weekday.

schedule.name: Schedule
schedule.description: Wake-up time per weekday, e.g. {"mon": "07:00:00"}. Days left out have no alarm.
